marriott-2023.business_judgement: Read line by line against the filing. Two bold stand-alone lines are the item's top-level categories (Risks Relating to Our Industry, Risks Relating to Our Business); four underlined stand-alone lines are the categories inside the second (Operational Risks; Development and Financing Risks; Technology, Information Protection, and Privacy Risks; Governance Risk); every other line is the bold sentence that opens one risk factor and leads into its body. Each is a heading of Item 1A under the approved definition's heading-level list, and no heading-marked line in the item is missing.

heading_lines.text: Risks Relating to Our Industry
Our industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully for guests
Economic and other global, national, and regional conditions and events have in the past impacted, and could in the future impact, our business, financial results and growth
Risks Relating to Our Business
Operational Risks
Premature termination of our management or franchise agreements could hurt our financial performance
Disagreements with owners of hotels that we manage or franchise may result in arbitration or litigation or delay implementation of product or service initiatives
An increase in the use of third-party Internet services to book online hotel reservations could adversely impact our business

Our growth strategy depends upon attracting third-party owners and franchisees to our platform, and future arrangements with these third parties may be less favorable to us, depending on the terms offered by our competitors

The effects of, or our failure to comply with, applicable laws, regulations and government policies may disrupt our business, lower our revenues, increase our costs, reduce our profits, limit our growth, or damage our reputation.
Exchange rate fluctuations could result in significant foreign currency gains and losses and affect our business results

Our business depends on the quality and reputation of our Company and our brands, and any deterioration could adversely impact our market share, reputation, business, financial condition, or results of operations
Actions by our franchisees and licensees or others could adversely affect our image and reputation

Collective bargaining activity and strikes could materially disrupt our operations, increase our labor costs, and interfere with the ability of our management to focus on executing our business strategies
Our business could suffer if we cannot attract and retain associates or as the result of the loss of the services of our senior executives

Extreme weather, natural disasters, climate change, and sustainability-related concerns have impacted our business in the past and could in the future have a material adverse effect on our business and results of operations.
Insurance may not cover damage to, or losses involving, properties that we own, manage, or franchise, or other aspects of our business, and the cost of such insurance could increase
If our brands, goodwill, or other intangible assets become impaired, we may be required to record significant non-cash charges to earnings.
Our Loyalty Program plays a significant role in our business and unfavorable developments affecting the program could adversely affect our business and results of operations.
Development and Financing Risks
Our hotel owners and franchisees depend on capital to buy, develop, and improve hotels, and they may be unable to access capital when necessary
Our ability to grow our management and franchise systems is subject to the range of risks associated with real estate investments
Our owned properties and other real estate investments subject us to numerous risks
Risks associated with development and sale of residential properties associated with our lodging properties or brands may reduce our profits
More hotel projects in our development pipeline may be cancelled or delayed in opening, which could adversely affect our growth prospects
Losses on loans or loan guarantees that we have made to third parties impact our profits
If owners of hotels that we manage or franchise cannot repay or refinance mortgage loans secured by their properties, our revenues and profits could decrease and our business could be harmed
Technology, Information Protection, and Privacy Risks
Any disruption in the functioning of our reservation, Loyalty Program, or other core operational systems could adversely affect our performance and results
A failure to keep pace with developments in technology could impair our operations or competitive position
We are exposed to risks and costs associated with protecting the integrity and security of Company, associate, and guest data
The Data Security Incident, and other information security incidents, could have numerous adverse effects on our business
Additional cybersecurity incidents could have adverse effects on our business.
Changes in privacy and data security laws could increase our operating costs and increase our exposure to payment obligations and litigation
Changes in laws could adversely affect our ability to market our products effectively
Governance Risk
Delaware law and our governing corporate documents contain, and our Board of Directors could implement, anti-takeover provisions that could deter takeover attempts.
